白仙的虚影盯着杨童看了许久，周身的金光和黑气，渐渐交织在一起，最终化作一道柔和的白光，缓缓落在胡九郎的身上。

胡九郎明显感受到一股温暖的力量，涌入体内，驱散着他体内的阴寒之气，他微弱的呼吸，渐渐变得平稳起来，苍白的脸色也泛起了一丝淡淡的红晕。

看到这一幕，杨童嘴角露出一抹虚弱的笑容，可她的身体，却再也支撑不住，眼前一黑，重重地倒在地上，手腕上的鲜血，依旧在流淌，只是流速渐渐变慢了。

“丫头！”

李二牛惊呼一声，拿出止血的草药和布条，快速给杨童包扎手腕，阻止血液继续流淌。

他能感受到，杨童的生机已经损耗了大半，气息微弱，随时都有可能昏迷不醒。

白仙的虚影看着倒在地上的杨童，又看了看渐渐好转的胡九郎，眼底闪过一丝复杂的情绪，随后缓缓化作一道白光，消失在房间里，只留下一丝柔和的气息，萦绕在房间内，护着胡九郎和杨童。

“太好了！白仙原谅我们了！”

门口的范梦雪，忍不住小声欢呼起来，眼里满是喜悦，可看到倒在地上的杨童，喜悦又瞬间被担忧取代。

李二牛一边给杨童包扎，一边沉声道：

“白仙已经收回了阴寒之气，胡九郎很快就会醒过来，但是杨童，损耗了太多生机，失血也很多，能不能醒过来还要看她自己的造化。我们现在能做的就是好好照顾他们，等待他们醒来。”

林佳、阡陌和苏笑笑，也立刻走进房间，小心翼翼地将胡九郎和杨童扶到床上躺下，盖上被子

杨童的手腕已经被包扎好，可她的脸色依旧苍白如纸，呼吸微弱，眉头紧紧皱着，像是在承受着巨大的痛苦。

胡九郎躺在床上，眉头渐渐舒展，呼吸越来越平稳。

房间内一片寂静，众人默默守在床边，眼神中满是担忧和期盼，他们不知道，杨童能不能醒过来，也不知道，醒来之后，他们还要面对多少危险，可他们知道，这一次杨童用自己的命，换来了胡九郎的生机，也换来了白仙的一丝原谅。

胡九郎也不知过了多久，他睫毛轻轻颤动，缓缓睁开了双眼。

视线还有些模糊，入目是熟悉的房梁，鼻尖萦绕着香灰、草药与淡淡的血腥味。

胡九郎他动了动手指，浑身依旧酸软无力，可意识却异常清晰，幻境里的相爱和背叛，白仙虚影的寒气，还有自己扑上去护住杨童的那一幕，全都历历在目。

Bai Xian's shadow stared at Yang Tong for a long time. The golden light and black energy around him gradually intertwined, and finally turned into a soft white light, which slowly fell on Hu Jiulang's body.

Hu Jiulang clearly felt a warm force pouring into his body, dispelling the cold air in his body. His weak breathing gradually became steady, and a faint blush appeared on his pale face.

Seeing this scene, Yang Tong showed a weak smile on her lips, but her body could no longer support her. Her vision went dark and she fell heavily to the ground. The blood on her wrists was still flowing, but the flow rate gradually slowed down.

"Girl!"

Li Erniu exclaimed, took out the herbs and cloth strips to stop the bleeding, and quickly bandaged Yang Tong's wrist to stop the blood from continuing to flow.

He could feel that most of Yang Tong's vitality had been lost, his breath was weak, and he might fall into coma at any time.

Bai Xian's shadow looked at Yang Tong who fell on the ground, and then at Hu Jiulang who was getting better. A complex emotion flashed in his eyes, and then slowly turned into a white light and disappeared into the room, leaving only a soft breath lingering in the room, protecting Hu Jiulang and Yang Tong.

"Great! Bai Xian forgives us!"

Fan Mengxue, who was at the door, couldn't help but cheer softly, her eyes filled with joy. But when she saw Yang Tong lying on the ground, her joy was instantly replaced by worry.

Li Erniu bandaged Yang Tong and said in a deep voice:

"Bai Xian has withdrawn the cold energy. Hu Jiulang will wake up soon, but Yang Tong has lost too much vitality and lost a lot of blood. Whether she can wake up depends on her own luck. All we can do now is take good care of them and wait for them to wake up."

Lin Jia, Qian Mo and Su Xiaoxiao also walked into the room immediately, carefully helped Hu Jiulang and Yang Tong to lie down on the bed, and covered them with quilts.

Yang Tong's wrist has been bandaged, but her face is still as pale as paper, her breathing is weak, and her brows are furrowed tightly, as if she is suffering from great pain.

Hu Jiulang lay on the bed, his brows gradually relaxed and his breathing became more and more steady.

There was silence in the room, and everyone stood by the bed silently, with their eyes full of worry and expectation. They didn't know if Yang Tong could wake up, and they didn't know how many dangers they would face after waking up. But they knew that this time Yang Tong used his own life to gain Hu Jiulang's life, and also gained Bai Xian's forgiveness.

Hu Jiulang didn't know how long it had passed. His eyelashes trembled slightly and he slowly opened his eyes.

His vision was still a little blurry, but he saw the familiar beams of the house, and the tip of his nose was lingering with the smell of incense ash, herbs and a faint smell of blood.

Hu Jiulang moved his fingers. His whole body was still weak and weak, but his consciousness was extremely clear. The love and betrayal in the illusion, the cold air of Bai Xian's shadow, and the scene where he rushed to protect Yang Tong were all vivid in his mind.
